description: Ministry of skills Development Employment and Labour Relations - Revocation of order under the Industrial Disputes Act that publish in the Gaz. Ex. No. 2083/16 of 09.08.2018. Mr. H. K. Nimal vs. State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka and 03 other Notices
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act, including the appointment of arbitrators for industrial disputes and the revocation of previous orders. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory powers, and regulatory actions rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the exercise of statutory powers under existing legislation.
